answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new copper and a jury of peers. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the haven expensive rather than free. Seal 1cvz8.
